summary: Frontend Lenis regression testing: wheel and work anchor passed, but contact/nav verification reproduced a black/unstyled visual state and contact anchor cannot align section top at document bottom.

ui_bugs.component: Portfolio page rendering during/after Lenis navigation
ui_bugs.issue: Public preview repeatedly shows a large solid black region followed by unstyled/default-looking content; this matches the reported black-frame symptom and makes sections visually unusable.

integration_issues.issue: Click reaches document bottom with contact top around 850px rather than requested offset; contact remains visible but anchor cannot position section at top because scrolling is clamped at document max.

action_items: Investigate why the public build renders a black/unstyled state after Lenis anchor navigation; inspect CSS loading/build output and dark-process sizing.
Adjust contact anchor behavior or expected alignment for bottom-clamped sections.
critical_code_review_comments: App.css is only 8 lines and index.css only 3 lines while App.js relies on many class-based visual rules; verify the intended stylesheet is actually present and loaded in the deployed bundle.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop public preview: hero loads, no horizontal overflow, View my work lands at #work, and three wheel events advance continuously. Repeated nav Contact test ends at scrollY ~18532 with #contact top ~850 and screenshot shows black upper region plus default-looking content. Overlay recovery/mobile tests were not reached after this reproducible failure.
rca of the issue: Likely CSS/deployed-bundle regression rather than Lenis alone: source stylesheets contain only Lenis/mobile/portrait overrides, but the JSX uses extensive class selectors with no definitions in these files. During navigation the dark process section is black while subsequent sections appear unstyled. Confirm CSS source/build artifact and Lenis scroll bounds.
